dedupe_keys.name: abstractswarm graphical multi agent modelling and simulation environment for logistics applied to hospital processes

description: AbstractSwarm is a graphical multi-agent modelling and simulation environment for logistics problems, developed as an open-source project and planned to be applied to optimising hospital processes. Users model a logistics problem graphically at agent level, as agents, stations and time constraints, and then plug in agent implementations that try to solve it cooperatively; the project encourages machine learning and other artificial intelligence methods for agents that can solve one model and new models not known in advance, and runs a multi-agent logistics competition with test scenarios and tutorials. Demo scenarios such as multi-agent shortest paths come with the release. The software is written in Java, runs on Windows directly and on Linux through Wine or Java, and is free under the GNU General Public License version 3 from GitLab, where it has been developed since 2019 with activity in 2026. Coverage is any logistics system a user models. Caveats: hospital applications are planned, not documented on the repository, the modelling abstraction is general, and documentation is limited. Simulation uses: modelling hospital logistics such as patient transport, porters and supply delivery, and testing AI scheduling agents. Related records: Ciw (model-ciw-queueing-network-simulation) and the treat-sim model (model-treat-sim-treatment-centre-des) model hospital patient flow as queues.
